name: Cmon Internet
summary: Dialup + ADSL ISP ('Cmon 24/7'; site at cmon.com.au/portal/, ~2003-05); retail portal gone by 2006, domain parked thereafter.

events.details: Dialup + residential ADSL; ISP site at cmon.com.au/portal/ (dialup + ADSL plans) captured from Jun 2003.
Retail portal pages returning 404 by Aug 2006; homepage a domain-parking page from Oct 2007, 302 redirect (parked) thereafter.
